AKWF_aguitar.name: Acoustic guitar

AKWF_bitreduced.name: Bit-reduced

AKWF_bw_perfectwaves.about: Clean band-limited sine, saw, square and triangle.

AKWF_c604.name: C604 synth

AKWF_sinharm.name: Sine harmonics

AKWF_snippets.name: Snippets
